config.signal: overnight BTC gap -> same-day open trade on COIN/MSTR/MARA

definitions.market_close: prev TRADING day 16:00 ET -> today 9:30 ET (Monday spans the weekend, 65.5h; weekend_gap is a near-special case)
definitions.overnight_only: prev CALENDAR day 16:00 ET -> today 9:30 ET (always ~17.5h; Monday = Sunday 16:00 -> Monday 9:30 only)

config.btc_price_convention: close of the last 1h bar known at or before the ET timestamp (exact at 16:00 ET; the 9:00 ET bar close at 9:30 ET — look-ahead safe); endpoints with no bar within 2h skip the day
config.entry: event-day OPEN, equal weight across targets with data (COIN pre-IPO skipped)
config.sizing: score = sign * min(|ret|/(2*threshold), 1) in [0.5,1]; notional = |score| * equity at entry
config.gross_exposure_cap: new entries limited so total gross (prev-day-close marks of open legs + new notional) <= 2.0x equity at entry; events crowded out below 5% of equity are skipped and counted as n_capped_events (matters mainly at the 2% threshold where events cluster on consecutive days)

conventions.windows: events assigned by ENTRY date; pre/post 2023-03 split mirrors the weekend_gap training/OOS boundary (gap in 2023-03 intentional)
conventions.half_split: front/back halves split at the median trading day 2022-11-02
conventions.per_event_returns: net of IBKR costs, from the full-window equity path (PnL is path-independent; sizing path only affects min-commission, negligible)
conventions.boundary_trades: exits beyond the window are kept for stats; equity marked at the window's last close

stock_gap_vs_btc_overnight.note: avg equal-weight stock opening gap vs BTC overnight return; beta = stock gap per unit BTC move (under-reaction < 1)

gap_continuation.note: returns signed by trade direction; positive = gap continues. full_fill = same-day close crosses back through the pre-gap stock close (weekend_gap reference: 0-20% fill)
